records.title: AgriSense: Crop Disease Detection and Agentic AI Chatbot
records.affiliation: Vidyalankar Institute of Technology, Wadala (East), Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
records.abstract: The paper proposes AgriSense, a farming assistant combining CNN-based crop disease detection with multilingual chatbot interaction, multiple large language models, and retrieval-augmented generation. It describes a ResNet50 classifier for Chickpea and Blackgram disease categories, a FastAPI backend, React frontend, and Supabase authentication and storage.
